searchText: phase two — gevurah: critique before expansion the awtsmoos is beyond price and possession; finite commerce needs strict boundaries so awtsmoos.com never confuses desire with authority. architecture tests do not create a second paid action system if the existing dirty tree already contains one. do not charge credits for a permanent entitlement unless grant and debit are atomic under one wallet lock. do not let repeat unlocks consume twice. do not let browser supplied productid, amount, or purpose become authority. do not render a theme as owned until account testimony says it is owned. do not make premium cosmetics obstruct reading, focus, reduced motion, high contrast, or low power devices. do not create one huge capability manifest; split product truth from capability definitions and presentation metadata. do not edit long legacy apps merely to add monetization; shared shell adoption comes first. do not claim catalog/seo completeness until crawler visible html and canonical metadata are verified. do not hide unfinished product specific credit sinks; readiness scoring must expose them. improvement sequence 1. reconcile current paidactioncatalog/execution/handler modules. 2. choose one authoritative capability representation and remove conceptual duplication by extension, not deletion. 3. add universal radiance entitlement through the existing paid action execution path if that path already atomically handles fulfillment. 4. add product shell presentation only after backend testimony exists. 5. add tests before broad catalog claims. 6. generate crawlable inventory next because deployed apps/games still expose loading placeholders to crawlers. 7. continue into recents/search/workflows only after canonical graph generation is stable.
